title: You Can't Take It With You
description: An eccentric patriarch meets the stuffy parents of his granddaughter's fiancé.

title: Five Easy Pieces
description: A former concert pianist (Jack Nicholson) who works in an oil field takes his waitress girlfriend (Karen Black) to visit his wealthy, cultured family.

title: Oliver!
description: Dickens' Oliver Twist goes from parish boy to Fagin's pickpocketing school to the clutches of murderous Bill Sikes.

title: Funny Girl
description: Ziegfeld Follies star Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) falls for gambler Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif).

title: The Harder They Fall
description: A fight promoter (Rod Steiger) hires a hard-luck sportswriter (Humphrey Bogart) to hype a simple Argentine boxer for the mob.

title: Diamond Head
description: The head (Charlton Heston) of a Hawaiian pineapple dynasty refuses to let his sister (Yvette Mimieux) marry a native.

title: Forbidden
description: The mistress (Barbara Stanwyck) of a lawyer (Adolphe Menjou) running for governor marries an editor (Ralph Bellamy), who finds she has a baby.

title: Bonjour tristesse
description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. However, the arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend soon turns her world upside down.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: A World War II hero (Humphrey Bogart) solves his buddy's murder, starting with a singer (Lizabeth Scott) and a nightclub owner (Morris Carnovsky).

title: Mickey One
description: A nightclub comic (Warren Beatty) in debt to mobsters hides in Chicago at the mercy of his ego.

title: The Collector
description: A British butterfly collector kidnaps an art student, Miranda Grey, and keeps her in his farmhouse cellar.

title: American Madness
description: An idealistic bank officer is taken to task by the board of directors when they learn of his unorthodox loan policies.

title: Miss Sadie Thompson
description: A shady woman (Rita Hayworth) from San Francisco joins Marines and a moral reformer (Jose Ferrer) in the postwar Pacific.

title: The Undercover Man
description: Two Treasury agents (Glenn Ford, James Whitmore) set out to nail a mobster for tax evasion.

title: Don't Raise the Bridge, Lower the River
description: A dreamer (Jerry Lewis) and a British con man (Terry-Thomas) plot to steal an oil-drill invention and sell it to the Arabs.

title: The Happy Time
description: A violinist (Charles Boyer) and his brother (Louis Jourdan) guide one's son through his crush on the family maid in the 1920s Ottawa.

title: The Trouble With Angels
description: A headstrong girl (Hayley Mills) and her best friend (June Harding) bedevil the mother superior (Rosalind Russell) of a convent school.

title: Middle of the Night
description: A widowed manufacturer (Fredric March) falls in love with a divorced employee (Kim Novak) 30 years his junior.

title: Boston Blackie and the Law
description: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

title: Queen Bee
description: A boozing Atlanta millionaire's (Barry Sullivan) wicked wife (Joan Crawford) acts charming to people at their mansion.

title: Fire Down Below
description: A woman (Rita Hayworth) without a passport divides West Indies smugglers (Robert Mitchum, Jack Lemmon), then a fire threatens to sink a freighter.

title: Born Free
description: The British Adamsons raise Elsa the lioness as a pet in Kenya, then teach her how to be wild again.

title: Hellcats of the Navy
description: A submarine commander (Ronald Reagan) enters the Sea of Japan with a frogman who had flirted with his girlfriend (Nancy Davis).

title: The Whole Truth
description: A Hollywood producer's (Stewart Granger) wife (Donna Reed) does not believe he has stabbed his actress lover, another man's (George Sanders) wife.

title: Only Angels Have Wings
description: A sassy chorus girl (Jean Arthur) falls in love with a seat-of-the-pants pilot (Cary Grant) in South America.

title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: The Chance of a Lifetime
description: Sleuth Boston Blackie (Chester Morris) helps a wartime convict (Erik Rolf) framed for murder while out on parole.

title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
description: Sinbad the sailor (Kerwin Mathews) needs the egg of a giant two-headed bird of prey to restore a shrunken princess (Kathryn Grant).

title: The Howards of Virginia
description: Politics divide a Williamsburg couple (Cary Grant, Martha Scott) as events lead to the Revolutionary War.

title: Autumn Leaves
description: A New England spinster (Joan Crawford) marries a younger man (Cliff Robertson) who has mental problems and another wife (Vera Miles).

title: Port Afrique
description: An American (Phil Carey) returns to Morocco and discovers his wife's past while probing her death.

title: The Last Hurrah
description: An aging New England politician struggles to maintain his position as mayor in a hard-fought and questionable campaign.

title: First Men in the Moon
description: An old man (Edward Judd) recalls how he, his fiancée (Martha Hyer) and a professor (Lionel Jeffries) planted a Union Jack on the moon in 1899.

title: The End of the Affair
description: A civil servant's wife (Deborah Kerr) in wartime London vows to leave her injured lover (Van Johnson) if he recovers.

title: Gidget Goes to Rome
description: Teenage Gidget (Cindy Carol) and boyfriend Moondoggie (James Darren) cause romantic confusion on vacation in Italy.

title: We Were Strangers
description: A Cuban (Jennifer Jones) lets a rebel (John Garfield) use her home as a base for digging a tunnel to blow up a dictatorship.

title: Oliver!
description: Dickens' Oliver Twist goes from parish boy to Fagin's pickpocketing school to the clutches of murderous Bill Sikes.

title: Eight Iron Men
description: GIs sit in a bombed-out house with a comrade trapped outside; then one (Bonar Colleano) does something.

title: The Black Knight
description: A common swordsmith (Alan Ladd) freelances for King Arthur to prove himself worthy of an earl's daughter (Patricia Medina).
